Name: IslandCraft - Equipment of Arrakis
Description: Equipment for survival on Arrakis, built as small modules on the vanilla Mana stat: a tool picker and tools (Cutter Ray, Compactor, LitreJon, Dew Harvester, Blood Extractor, Blood Bag), ten weapons, the Thumper, the Holtzman shield on the H key, Personal Light and a four-bar HUD.
